verdict.rationale: Runway Dev offers a broad first-party API: an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, text, image and video-to-video generation, Aleph editing, draft/enhance, ProRes/HDR outputs, Characters with custom voices, Recipes, and Workflows exposed as endpoints, plus an MCP server for agents. That covers much of the creative UI. Nothing in the evidence claims UI–API parity, though. Workflows must be built in the Runway app before they are published as endpoints, and several UI features have no evidenced API surface: Brand Kits, App Studio, Runway Ads publishing to Meta/Google/TikTok, 4K upscaling, and the AI video editor. Missing for 10: a documented UI–API parity claim, API coverage of Brand Kits/Ads/App Studio/upscaling/editor features, API-side workflow authoring, and independent corroboration.
